# RxLabs®

> Laboratorio de software de Roger Navarro (Girona, España). Investigación.

Site: https://www.rogexlaboratories.com
Docs: https://docs.rogexlaboratories.com
Contact: knightsys@proton.me

## What this site is

A landing page. Two products exist as software; they are not launched on the web yet (`/echos` and `/prisma` are 404).

## What exists

- **echOS 2.1.0-honest** — bare-metal x86_64 console unikernel. One ELF. No Linux. No desktop. In-kernel SNN (LIF / Q6). PCI probe for BrainChip Akida. Not a commercial OS. Not a web browser.
- **PRISMA** — EEG analysis software for research, plus a real-time Rust engine. Built on MNE-Python for numerics. Not a medical device. Does not diagnose, treat, or predict any condition.
